items.title: Content Creator and Social Media Marketing Intern
items.description:
About ShowStellar

ShowStellar is a Mumbai based startup building a platform that connects artists and performers with customers for events, celebrations, and entertainment experiences.


We are looking for creative and enthusiastic Content Creation and Social Media Marketing Interns who love making Instagram Reels, shooting videos, editing content, and experimenting with new ideas.


This internship is ideal for someone who enjoys creating content, understands social media trends, and wants hands on experience working with a growing startup.


Key Responsibilities


1. Create engaging Instagram Reels, short videos, and social media content for ShowStellar.
2. Shoot and edit videos featuring artists, performances, events, and behind the scenes activities.
3. Research trending audio, creative formats, and content ideas relevant to entertainment and events.
4. Develop creative concepts, scripts, hooks, and captions for Instagram Reels.
5. Work with the marketing team to plan and execute weekly content calendars.
6. Create promotional videos, artist introduction reels, and engaging storytelling content.
7. Design basic social media posts and creatives using Canva or similar tools.
8. Help grow ShowStellar’s Instagram presence through consistent and engaging organic content.

* Basic video shooting and editing skills.
* Familiarity with Instagram Reels and current social media trends.
* Experience with CapCut, VN, Canva, Premiere Pro, or similar editing tools.
* Creative thinking and storytelling ability.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Willingness to experiment with new content formats.


Who Can Apply


Students, fresh graduates, and aspiring content creators from any educational background are welcome to apply.


Prior professional experience is not mandatory. Candidates who have created personal Instagram Reels, college event videos, or other creative content are encouraged to apply.


What You Will Gain


* Hands on experience creating content for a real startup.
* Opportunities to work with artists, performers, and event professionals.
* Practical experience in video production, social media marketing, and brand building.
* Direct mentorship from the founding team.
* Internship certificate upon successful completion.
* Opportunity for extended engagement based on performance and business requirements.


Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra


Mode: In Office with occasional event shoots


Duration: 3 Months


We value creativity, consistency, initiative, and the willingness to learn more than academic qualifications.

items.title: Dsp Modulation Algorithm Design Am Fm and Analog Schemes Chiplet
items.description:
This internship focuses on DSP modulation algorithm design AM FM and analog schemes chiplet within the SDR radio development programme. The technical objective is to build practical understanding and implementation capability in this area. Development of analog modulation algorithm design, mathematical modeling, MATLAB simulation, and real time DSP implementation capabilities supporting AM and FM modulation and demodulation for narrowband voice communication waveforms.

The intern will study the module requirements and work through relevant engineering activities, including AM modulation algorithm design frameworks supporting DSB AM, DSB SC, and SSB modulation mathematical derivation, modulation index specification, carrier and sideband power relationship, and bandwidth calculation for voice signals.


AM demodulation algorithm implementation systems supporting envelope detector implementation for DSB AM, synchronous detector for DSB SC, SSB demodulation with carrier reinsertion, and performance comparison in MATLAB simulation.


FM modulation algorithm design architectures supporting frequency deviation calculation for voice bandwidth, pre emphasis filter design per standard, instantaneous frequency computation, and FM signal generation from digital baseband.


FM demodulation algorithm implementation frameworks supporting frequency discriminator design, limiter discriminator architecture, PLL based FM demodulator, and de emphasis filter design for voice output quality.


Work should connect the technical principles to the wider SDR system, with attention to interfaces, measurable performance, documentation, and verification wherever these are part of the module scope. The expected outcome is a clearly documented contribution that can be reviewed and considered during system level integration.
responsibilities: FM demodulation algorithm implementation frameworks supporting frequency discriminator design, limiter discriminator architecture, PLL based FM demodulator, and de emphasis filter design for voice output quality.

items.title: Transmitter Performance Measurement and Qualification Chiplet
items.description:
This internship focuses on transmitter performance measurement and qualification chiplet within the SDR radio development programme. The technical objective is to build practical understanding and implementation capability in this area. Development of complete transmitter performance measurement and qualification capabilities supporting output power, harmonic, spurious, frequency stability, modulation quality, and spectrum mask measurement with formal qualification test report generation.

The intern will study the module requirements and work through relevant engineering activities, including transmitter test bench setup and calibration frameworks supporting spectrum analyzer, signal generator, calibrated power meter, attenuators, dummy load, and RF cable VSWR verification for accurate transmitter measurements.


Output power measurement systems supporting calibrated power measurement at all five levels across multiple frequencies in the 30 to 512 MHz band, 10W High Power mode plus 1 and minus 2 dB tolerance verification, and power versus frequency flatness characterization.


Harmonic suppression measurement architectures supporting spectrum analyzer configuration for second and third harmonic search, marker measurement at harmonic frequencies, dBc calculation, and verification of greater than minus 50 dBc at all test points.


Spurious emissions measurement frameworks supporting wideband spectrum scan configuration, attenuator selection, marker measurement of all products above noise floor, and verification of less than or equal to minus 60 dBm for all spurious products.


Work should connect the technical principles to the wider SDR system, with attention to interfaces, measurable performance, documentation, and verification wherever these are part of the module scope. The expected outcome is a clearly documented contribution that can be reviewed and considered during system level integration.

items.title: Azure Cloud Admin Launchpad Internship AZ-104 Track
items.description:
EWB Edu Tech Private Limited (EWB Courses) offers a free, fully online 4 week Microsoft Azure Administrator internship designed for students and freshers who want to start a career in cloud computing. The first 2 weeks are live online classes with guided hands-on labs, and weeks 3 and 4 are a project phase where interns build a real Azure project. The program is built around the core skills of the Microsoft AZ-104 Azure Administrator certification path. This internship is an independent training program and is not affiliated with Microsoft. Week 1 (Live Classes): Azure Foundations and Compute. Cloud computing basics, service models and deployment models. Azure account setup, free tier limits, subscriptions and resource groups. Azure Active Directory basics: creating users and groups, and role based access control (RBAC) with Reader, Contributor and Owner roles. Launching and managing Windows and Linux virtual machines, connecting to servers, hosting a simple web server, resizing a VM, taking disk snapshots and understanding availability sets and scale sets.
Week 2 (Live Classes): Storage, Networking and Operations. Azure storage accounts and Blob storage, access keys, shared access signatures (SAS), storage redundancy, access tiers and static website hosting. Virtual networks (VNET), subnets, network security groups (NSG), load balancers and VNET peering. Managing Azure with Azure CLI, monitoring with Azure Monitor alerts and metrics, and protecting workloads with Azure Backup.
Weeks 3 and 4 (Project Phase): Interns apply everything learned in the live classes to a hands-on project. Deploy a virtual machine inside a secured virtual network, publish a static website from Azure storage, configure network security rules, set up a monitoring alert and a backup. Project work is reviewed by mentors, followed by a final project submission and review.
What you will gain: Practical Azure administration skills that employers look for. A real project to add to your resume and LinkedIn profile. Live classes, task reviews and mentor support. A certificate of completion from EWB Edu Tech Private Limited on successfully completing the project.
Who can apply: Students and freshers from any stream with basic computer knowledge and a strong interest in cloud and IT careers. No prior Azure experience is needed. You only need a laptop, a stable internet connection and a free Azure account.
This internship is completely free. No fee is charged at any stage.
How to apply: Fill the registration form at https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfAHBPBRXpGCI8q0wOJbiS_HNaVJkDseRJlBGbu_uB0fyOSog/viewform and join the official Azure WhatsApp community at https://chat.whatsapp.com/IsGA55r7qgS6IZJ3YPHqgh for class links and updates.

items.title: Artificial Intelligence Internship - Computer Vision and NLP Projects
items.description:
IMTDA Infotech (OPC) Private Limited is a DPIIT-recognised AI and EdTech startup based in Visakhapatnam, and an approved organisation on the AICTE Internship Portal. This is a free, remote internship: no fee of any kind is collected from interns, and nothing has to be bought to join or complete it. In this 4 month internship you will build a working AI application on a live project. Month 1: Python for AI, NumPy, Pandas and machine learning foundations. Month 2: neural networks and deep learning with TensorFlow or PyTorch. Month 3: computer vision with OpenCV, such as object detection or video analytics, and an introduction to natural language processing. Month 4: complete your project, write the report and present it. You will use Git and GitHub throughout and finish with a documented project in your portfolio. Basic programming knowledge in any language is preferred. All tools used are free and open source.
How it works: you are matched with a dedicated mentor, attend a weekly review call, and keep a daily diary that your mentor reviews every week. At the end you submit a project report and present your work. On successful completion you receive a completion certificate free of cost, stating your dates, duration and hours, and top performers receive a letter of recommendation. Attendance records and a mentor evaluation sheet can be shared with your college for internship credit.

items.title: Programming Foundation with Python
items.description:
This course introduces students to Python programming, focusing on developing strong programming fundamentals and practical problem-solving skills. Students will learn Python syntax, variables, data types, operators, conditional statements, loops, functions, and built-in collections such as lists, tuples, sets, and dictionaries. The course also covers file handling, exception handling, modules, packages, and the fundamentals of object-oriented programming (OOP). Through hands-on exercises and real-world coding scenarios, students will develop programs to solve practical problems, manage data using files and collections, and create reusable code components. Students will also gain experience in debugging, writing structured programs, and improving code efficiency. As a final practical activity, students will develop a mini-project such as a Student Record Management System, Expense Tracker, or Automation Utility, applying the concepts learned throughout the course.


Key learning areas - Core Python, variables, data types, operators, conditional statements, loops, functions, collections, file handling, exception handling, modules and packages, and introduction to object-oriented programming.
Practical activities / deliverables:
1 -Develop Python programs to solve practical problems.
2 - Work with files, functions, collections and reusable modules.
3 - Build a mini-project such as a student record system, expense tracker or automation utility.
Expected outcome: Students will gain a strong foundation in Python programming, logical thinking, debugging and application development.
